name: Spicy Thai-Style Chicken Caesar Salad with Cucumber, Radish & Croutons

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Cut bread into 1-inch cubes and transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 slices whole grain bread
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp coriander, ground
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, tossing halfway through, until the croutons are golden and toasted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, place dressing and curry paste in a large bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup Caesar dressing
2 tbsp Thai curry paste, red

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ bunches radish
6 hearts romaine hearts

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Place chickens on the cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces, add to the bowl, and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (850 g) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with croutons. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
